title: I Thought I Was Crazy no
content: As long as I can remember I've always had a dream in the set mall, the highway to get there is like a roller coaster (which I hated because I'm scared of heights). Inside the mall is huge with stores that don't have names. The elevators never work so I have to take the stairs. The food court is huge with an escalator that leads up to an attached movie theater that's a purple and red color. No matter what I dream if I have to buy anything I end up at this mall. Well last night I dreamed I was back at this mall but this time there was a school attached and I seen the back rooms. I've never seen the back rooms or anything else outside the mall, the food court, movie theater and the crazy highway. And since tiktok has been acting weird I haven't seen anything else about Mall World. I can't tell my friends because they think I'm crazy and it's a conspiracy theory. This dream felt different I was aware of my surroundings and knew it was Mall World, once I had the thought of where I was my whole dream changed. Again I tried to explain to my friends but they don't get it. I have to get this off my chest because it's driving me crazy! Also I think I was apart of the GATE program but again my friends think I'm crazy.
